name: speakable-steps
text: Talk me through the first steps I should take after getting a Basic Food benefits warning letter that says I need to send proof of income to keep benefits.

name: repair-call
text: Talk me through what to say out loud before I call my landlord about an eviction notice that says pay or vacate, including how to ask about legal deadlines and next steps.

name: medicine-label
text: Talk me through how to read this label out loud: take one tablet by mouth twice daily, do not take with alcohol, call doctor if dizzy.

name: immigration-appointment
text: Talk me through what to say when I call an immigration clinic about a USCIS request for evidence on my work permit renewal, including what documents and deadline I should ask them to check.

name: appointment-anxiety
text: Talk me through getting ready for a regular appointment when I am anxious and keep forgetting what I wanted to ask.
